newsitem.title: CANADA: Suncor cuts Canada posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Suncor cuts Canada posted oil prices.

text.p: Suncor Energy Inc said on Friday it lowered the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$10.00/cubic metre or C$1.59/barrel, to C$160.00cubic metre or C$25.44/barrel, effective immediately.
Other new prices were listed as follows: Cromer light sour C$150.00/cubic metre, or C$23.85/barrel Midale at Cromer C$134.00/cubic metre, or C$21.30/barrel ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
